tools.description: Aigine Redact detects and masks personal data and confidential information in documents. This opens a secure upload button so you can send a PDF, DOCX, PPTX or image (up to 50 MB) directly to Aigine's EU server. The file never passes through the chat. tools.name: propose_masking
tools.description: Detects and masks personal data (GDPR, including Art. 9 special categories) and confidential information (trade secrets, procurement tenders, FOIA exemptions, and statutory secrecy such as Swedish OSL) in a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, or image document. Takes the document as upload_id (from create_upload_link)

tools.name: fetch_reviewed_document
tools.description: Returns a temporary download_url for the masked PDF of a document whose web GUI review is finished (doc_id from propose_masking). After delivery, the document is deleted from the processing server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "propose_masking" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch_reviewed_document · Private data: create_upload_link, propose_masking, fetch_reviewed_document · Public sink: create_upload_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch_reviewed_document · Private data: create_upload_link, propose_masking, fetch_reviewed_document · Public sink: create_upload_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_upload_link" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
